column1: # Human SEC calibration anchor set v2 (2026-11-17, DECISION Pedro): = anchor set v1 (anchors_native_mass_human.tsv, the
# Jurkat v7 set, still used by preset legacy_v7) minus 4 consistent outliers that elute far larger than their native mass
# in every human dataset (residual <= -0.31 log10, i.e. >= 2x too large, in lab 2026 JurkatNT, JurkatTCRAct24h and
# Fossati 2021; the four largest residuals in Fossati): PFN1 (profilin, binds actin / poly-Pro partners), HSP90AB1 and
# HSPA8 (chaperones bound to clients / co-chaperones), YWHAZ (14-3-3, bound to phospho-partners). Not removed (not
# consistent): CFL1 (-0.50/-0.37/-0.30), NPM1 (lab -0.44/-0.46, Fossati +0.02). Rows otherwise identical to v1.
# Species: human. Role in the toolkit: THE calibration (primary) of preset default (calibration.anchor_set: v2).
